title: Sixteen Missing Bars  (缺失的十六小节)

segments.t: 当星期天的夕阳将院子里的灯笼染成金色时，伊芙琳小姐坐在走廊的桌旁，面前放着五线谱纸和一支软铅笔，而卡莱布则为她和汉娜端来热薄荷茶。让我们先来听听整个场景。
Tessa sent hot mint tea and warm almond biscuits for our composer!
Thank you both. Listen while I tap two rhythms on the table.
Does the ending go fast and bright, or gentle and slow?
Arthur's aunt wrote a light dancing beginning, like morning footsteps.
Then in the middle, the melody climbs up like afternoon conversation!
Exactly! So at six in the evening, how should a Friday waltz end?
Warm and unhurried, like friends lingering over their last cup of tea.
Yes! Repeat the opening four notes softly, one octave higher, and come home.
Just hearing you hum it in this glass room sounds wonderful, Evelyn!
Wait, right in bar twenty-eight, the melody lands squarely on middle D!
The exact silent key Graham is repairing tomorrow morning!
No pressure for poor Graham. The whole song rests on his tweezers!
现在让我们慢慢重温每一句。
Tessa sent hot mint tea and warm almond biscuits for our composer!
'泰莎为我们的作曲家送来了热薄荷茶和温热的杏仁饼干！'
Thank you both. Listen while I tap two rhythms on the table.
'谢谢你们俩。听着，我在桌上用手指敲出两个节奏。'
Does the ending go fast and bright, or gentle and slow?
'结尾是快而明快，还是轻柔而缓慢？'
Arthur's aunt wrote a light dancing beginning, like morning footsteps.
'阿瑟的姑姑写了一个轻盈跳跃的开头，就像早晨的脚步声。'
Then in the middle, the melody climbs up like afternoon conversation!
'然后在中间部分，旋律像午后的交谈一样上升！'
Exactly! So at six in the evening, how should a Friday waltz end?
'没错！那么在下午六点，星期五的圆舞曲应该如何结尾呢？'
Warm and unhurried, like friends lingering over their last cup of tea.
'温暖而从容，就像朋友们在最后一杯茶前流连忘返地聊天。'
Yes! Repeat the opening four notes softly, one octave higher, and come home.
'对！轻轻地重复开头的四个音符，高一个八度，然后回家。'
Just hearing you hum it in this glass room sounds wonderful, Evelyn!
'伊芙琳，光是在这个玻璃房间里听你哼唱就觉得太棒了！'
Wait, right in bar twenty-eight, the melody lands squarely on middle D!
'等等，就在第二十八小节，旋律不偏不倚地落在中央 D 上！'
The exact silent key Graham is repairing tomorrow morning!
'正好就是格雷厄姆明天早上要修的那颗哑键！'
No pressure for poor Graham. The whole song rests on his tweezers!
'可怜的格雷厄姆没有压力。整首歌都全靠他的镊子了！'
让我们把整个场景连起来再听一遍。

Yes! Repeat the opening four notes softly, one octave higher, and come home.

No pressure for poor Graham. The whole song rests on his tweezers!
伊芙琳小姐用铅笔草拟了一个充满温情的结尾，其中决定性的音符稳稳地落在中央 D 上。现在我们去厨房进行菜单试菜吧。
Have a nice evening!
